test_cases.what_to_try: On the learning path, say beforehand which of the two top star buttons I can use, then press the green ringed one and read its card without pressing CONTINUE, close it, and press the grey one below and read its card.
test_cases.real_if: I could not tell beforehand which one would let me start something, or one did something I did not predict.
test_cases.not_real_if: I could tell from what was on the screen, before pressing, which was which.
test_cases.what_happened: Before pressing I guessed the green one with the ring was the one I could use, but only from its colour, since neither button has a word on it. I pressed the green one. Both did what I had guessed, and each card named what it was in plain words. But I could not have known before pressing; I relied on colour, and I will not remember tomorrow that grey means locked.
